intent: independent pose repaint from current approved sprite target

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
EDIT TARGET IMAGE 1: our approved cast/E/01 ready sprite with correct registration. Create ONE independently repainted next animation pose, cast/E/02. Change only the pose described below. Preserve the character's exact identity, face design, painted finish, camera, HEAD/FACE PIXEL SCALE, prop pixel scale, costume design, and overall placement from Image 1. Do not enlarge the character to fill the canvas; preserve the same transparent canvas footprint and invisible ground. Never copy or warp an existing frame.
Image 2 is authoritative identity and hand ownership (RIGHT hand = exactly FIVE rectangular red/gold flame talisman cards, LEFT hand = bronze bell/red tassel). Image 3 is E side camera reference, its overlapping hands are ambiguous so ownership follows Image 2. Image 4 is main approved hand-painted style/material/finish reference only, ignore UI.
Pose: Face and gaze point SCREEN RIGHT. Camera-near arm is anatomical RIGHT and carries the red talisman fan; camera-far arm is anatomical LEFT and holds the bronze bell. Early gathering. Keep the starting side-facing stance with both shoes planted. Bend knees just slightly, pelvis down by about 1% of canvas height, weight subtly rearward. Near anatomical RIGHT elbow draws the FIVE-CARD red fan inward and a little upward from lower chest to mid-chest; thumb and fingers grip the card bases visibly. Far anatomical LEFT elbow begins lifting the bronze bell from behind hip to behind lower ribs, maintaining the bell on the rear screen-left side of the body, never jumping in front of the torso. Expression becomes focused. A small distinct change from the starting image, not a full release lunge.
Registration is essential: keep target Image 1's SAME head, face and all body-part pixel sizes. Ground stays at 90% canvas height (y920 in1024), virtual root at horizontal50%. Target's normal highest ponytail/crown silhouette is around14%-15%; allow only physically natural small up/down movement from knee bend, NOT changing character scale. Keep a CLEAR EMPTY 10% bottom transparent margin below the invisible ground. Full body and all props within square canvas, fixed orthographic E side camera, no zoom, no crop or bounding-box auto-fit.
Both hands visible gripping physically; keep five cards distinct as FIVE separate red rectangular panels, no closed folding fan; one bronze bell only. Two clearly separate legs/shoes, realistic knee/ankle joints within short chibi proportions.
Native single square RGBA frame at least1024, intended1024x1024 export. True transparent alpha. No background, ground, shadow, checkerboard, text, labels, detached particles, fire, aura, glow, projectiles or trails. No duplicate/extra anatomy. Bright clean rounded Taoist chibi hand painting, no plastic gloss.
